area: game fix: enemy line-of-sight now uses the wave broadphase, ending the built-but-unqueried grid

find.report_claim: cycle 139 recorded that shooter/sim.py built the wall SpatialGrid every wave and never queried it, so the structure cost a rebuild for no gameplay effect
find.live_evidence: three ray consumers scanned all 12 colliders linearly: _enemy_has_los (sim.py:349, called up to three times per enemy per tick), aim_target (sim.py:430) and _fire (sim.py:711)
find.consumer_evidence: a per-segment micro-benchmark on the real arena measured 122.5 us for the full 12-box scan against 49.7 us for a grid query plus exact re-test, with the candidate set averaging 0.72 of 12 boxes

killed: removing the grid: the structure is correct and the LOS path is hot, so the cheaper fix is to read it
routing aim_target and _fire through the grid: both cast unbounded rays, so bounding the query would make a distant wall invisible and change whether a target counts as blocked
claiming an end-to-end speedup: repeated kite replays on this machine ranged from 7.6s to 91.4s for the same build because another worker was active, so no wall-clock claim is defensible
analyze.survivor: prefilter only the bounded enemy-to-player segment, keep the exact ray_aabb decision, and prove equivalence against the previous full scan rather than trusting one replay hash

fix.shooter: shooter/sim.py adds _collider_by_key (built alongside the grid inserts) and _colliders_along(start, end) which queries the grid with the segment's AABB; _enemy_has_los iterates that candidate list, preserving the exact ray test, the length - 0.3 margin and the insertion order that decides the first blocking box; tests/test_los_broadphase.py (4 tests) proves the prefilter never drops a blocking box across 81 arena positions, matches the full-scan verdict across 200 swept positions, preserves collider build order, and can reach every wall

shooter.equivalence: test_los_broadphase.py: 4 passed in 1.12s; 81 positions checked for a dropped blocker, 200 swept positions for verdict parity, zero disagreements
shooter.determinism: 1800 ok, hash b25db52005e7aeb8a241f86d27b4d049 (unchanged); a 3000-frame --simulate run hashed identically (640c130c00ab6a48fd6ccadb0f02830b) on both the prefilter and the full-scan build
shooter.performance: micro-benchmark on the shipped arena: 122.5 us -> 49.7 us per LOS segment (candidates 0.72/12); end-to-end timing rejected as unmeasurable under concurrent load (7.6s..91.4s spread)
